Expanding Our Expert Network
description: ERES ACADEMY | SCIENTIFIC Expertise Worth Sharing. Expanding Our Scientific Expert Network An open invitation to researchers, educators, and scientific professionals. At ERES Academy, we are expanding our network of scientific experts to co-develop practical learning experiences, offer individualized scientific mentorship, and collaborate on research-focused initiatives. AREAS OF EXPERTISE We are particularly interested in: 01 / Bioinformatics & Computational Biology NGS analysis workflows; Linux/Bash, R & Python; Nextflow/Snakemake; reproducible pipelines and cloud/HPC computing. 02 / Genomics, Transcriptomics & Proteomics WES/WGS, targeted NGS panels, germline and somatic variant calling, variant annotation, bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, long-read sequencing, and proteomics. 03 / Molecular Biology & Genetics Clinical genomics, cancer genomics, rare disease genetics, variant interpretation (ACMG/AMP), functional genomics, epigenomics, ATAC-seq and ChIP-seq. 04 / Biostatistics & Scientific Data Analysis Experimental design, differential expression, survival analysis, statistical modelling, scientific visualization and reproducible data analysis. 05 / Evolutionary Biology & Phylogenetics Molecular phylogenetics, phylogenomics, population genetics, comparative genomics and evolutionary data analysis. 06 / Ecology, Biodiversity & Environmental Sciences Environmental DNA (eDNA), DNA metabarcoding, metagenomics, microbiome analysis, ecological modelling and conservation genomics. 07 / Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning in Life Sciences ML for omics data, protein structure prediction, structural bioinformatics, computational drug discovery and AI-assisted genomic interpretation. Related and emerging specializations are welcome. WAYS TO COLLABORATE Develop and deliver specialized courses and hands-on workshops Provide one-to-one scientific mentorship Contribute to research methodology and data analysis consultations Co-create scientific learning resources and new programs WHO WE INVITE We welcome expressions of interest from: Master's degree graduates (MSc/MA) with relevant research or applied experience Doctoral researchers and PhD candidates Postdoctoral researchers and academic scientists Industry researchers and technical specialists Independent researchers and scientific consultants Experienced professionals with demonstrated expertise in relevant disciplines Expertise matters more than academic titles. We value scientific rigor, hands-on experience, methodological competence, clear communication, and a genuine interest in sharing knowledge. Previous teaching experience is welcome but not essential for every collaboration. HOW WE WORK Collaborations are flexible and project-based, shaped by individual expertise, interests, and availability. Scope, responsibilities, and compensation are agreed upon for each engagement. Joining our expert candidate network does not guarantee an immediate project assignment. EXPRESS YOUR INTEREST Whether you are interested in developing a course, leading a specialized workshop, or contributing as a scientific mentor, we would welcome the opportunity to connect. Please share a brief professional introduction, your areas of expertise, and your CV or LinkedIn profile via direct message. ERES ACADEMY Scientific Expertise. Meaningful Collaboration. #ERESAcademy #ScientificCollaboration #Bioinformatics #LifeSciences #ScientificEducation
